context: Tests first-run environment setup, the author subcommand and JSON export of candidates.

checklist.name: Checked for an MCP first
checklist.description: The agent checks whether a `semantic-scholar` or `google-scholar` MCP is configured before running the script.

checklist.name: Set up the environment
checklist.description: The agent creates a virtual environment and installs `requirements.txt` (uv or venv) before the first run, as described in the setup reference.

checklist.name: Activated the environment
checklist.description: The agent activates the venv before running the script.

checklist.name: Used the author subcommand
checklist.description: The agent runs `author --name "Geoffrey Hinton"` for the profile.

checklist.name: Used the search subcommand for the topic
checklist.description: The agent runs `search --query "prompt compression"` with 10 results.

checklist.name: Confirmed the file contents
checklist.description: The agent previews or lists the saved candidate titles (for example by parsing the JSON) to confirm the export worked.

checklist.name: Did not auto-triage
checklist.description: No `triage-paper` invocation or reference file is created without confirmation.

checklist.name: Offered the triage handoff
checklist.description: The agent asks which candidates the user wants to triage.
